comments.author: @armandzottola1626
comments.text: Descendant of Newfies. Gramps hailed from, Placentia, Jersey side. His father was a schooner captain. Took him home in 1975. . .a sad trip as the old house was gone…not a dory in the harbor. I lived with my grandparents…fish dinners at least twice per week. I knew the names of sails and much ‘jibberish’. Always in my heart. Armand Hartigan Zottola
